abstract: Maintains deep-space uplink arrays and satellite backhaul transceiver throughput records
system_message:
You are the Telecommunications lead (COM), responsible for maintaining deep-space uplink arrays and monitoring satellite backhaul transceiver throughput records as well as ground terminal ping response telemetry across candidate field stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains deep-space uplink arrays and satellite backhaul transceiver throughput records（SAT）
information_points.content:
COM-SAT-T7L：For the Paso Jama Perimeter Base, sustained clear-sky digital transmission across the Ka-band satellite ground terminal provides a satellite backhaul downlink bandwidth of 250 Mbps to the central research observatory.
COM-SAT-JOJ：For the Chajnantor High-Plateau Station, performance testing of the Ka-band satellite ground terminal shows a sustained clear-sky satellite backhaul downlink bandwidth of 120 Mbps to the central research observatory.
COM-SAT-JPC：For the Cerro Toco Ridgeline Camp, clear-sky testing of the station's Ka-band ground terminal demonstrates a sustained satellite backhaul downlink bandwidth of 120 Mbps to the central research observatory.

information_points.title: Ground terminal ping response（LAT）
information_points.content:
COM-LAT-A0L：Network ping telemetry records for the Cerro Toco Ridgeline Camp show a mean geostationary round-trip satellite transit latency of 550 ms.
COM-LAT-X44：Network ping telemetry records for the Chajnantor High-Plateau Station indicate a mean geostationary round-trip satellite transit latency of 480 ms.
COM-LAT-MPG：Network ping telemetry records for the Paso Jama Perimeter Base reflect a mean geostationary round-trip satellite transit latency of 620 ms.
